pages.title: Saturn
pages.text: A ringed gas giant. You cannot land on Saturn itself. Land on Enceladus or Titan with a tier 5 rocket. Mimas, Tethys, Dione, Rhea and Iapetus only stay on the map.

pages.title: Enceladus
pages.text: A very cold icy moon known for its geysers. Gravity is about 27% of Earth's. It has coal and unknown crystals. The dungeon boss is an Ice Blaze. Bring your best thermal protection.

pages.title: Titan
pages.text: The only moon with thick air. Gravity is about 27% of Earth's. There is wind and precipitation, but you still cannot breathe. Titan is rich: diamonds, sapphires, emeralds, coal, lapis and redstone.
